mix_per_day: 2 Easy + 2 Medium + 1 Hard; >=1 order completable in multiplayer; <=1 MP-only and never Hard; <=1 theatre; <=2 squad; <=1 dbno; <=2 per category; one order per stat family; no repeat within 14 days

hook_grammar.class:<c>: weapon class derived from the existing wpn_<wid> stat inside chal_bump
hook_grammar.NEW Nn: a new hook point, see new_hooks

N1.what: challenges.scr::chal_ai_killed - one line passing victim, killer and wid to daily.scr::daily_onKill (distance, weather, victim faction, killer downed, per-life and per-map tallies, multikill window)

N2.what: ammobox.scr ~:254 (the owner-found branch) - one line passing box owner + the resupplied player to daily.scr::daily_onResupply; 'under fire' reuses xp.scr::xp_revive_underfire's test (2+ Germans within 700 u)

N3.what: dbno.scr ~:1054 (beside chal_revive / chal_revive_target) - one line passing reviver + downed + the downed man's bleed clock (flags coop_dbno_elapsed / coop_dbno_timer_actual) to daily.scr::daily_onRevive

N4.what: medkit.scr::dbno_selfrevive success point - one line to daily.scr::daily_onSelfRevive

N5.what: dbno.scr::dbno_enter + player.scr death path - one line each to daily.scr::daily_onDown (ends the current 'life' for per-life tallies)

N6.what: challenges.scr::chal_officer_killed - one line passing officer + killer (fact.location / meansofdeath already there) to daily.scr; plus level.coop_officerWavesCalled++ in officer.scr::coop_officer_reinforcements

N7.what: challenges.scr::chal_mission_complete - one line to daily.scr::daily_onMission (map prefix/list, skill, coop_hardcore, coop_lmsLives, $player.size, coop_wentDownMap, level.coop_chalAlarmEver, level.coop_chal_radioPaid, the existing coop_chalL_usedNonPistol / usedNonBolt flags and a new usedNonAxis flag set by N1)

N8.what: player.cpp grenade kick (coop_grenadeKick block, ~:20533): count kicks on the player (script var coop_nadeKicks) and stamp the kicked projectile with its kicker so the kill path can credit 'killed by a kicked grenade'

N9.what: gun bracing: expose the brace envelope (0..1) and the carried-MG heat/overheated latch (STAT_MGHEAT) as player vars read by N1

N10.what: Player::EnterTurret / ExitTurret: expose the mounted TurretGun on the player (var coop_onTurret) so N1 can credit mounted-MG kills

N11.what: alarm.scr::alm_deactivate (has the player) - one line; alarmsnipers.scr spawn - tag the actor coop_asn = 1

N13.what: emotes.scr::emote_play - one line (Tab-wheel emotes ship in v1.10.62)

N14.what: weaponstate.scr RAISE_WEAPON (already sets flags coop_activeWeapon) - also stamp level.time so N1 can see a kill within 2 s of a draw
